relevance.rationale: A conference-proceedings article on Kuperberg A_2 (sl_3) web skein theory: a full-twist formula for one-row colored A_2 webs, applied to give an explicit one-row colored sl_3 tail of (2,2m)-torus links. Note the file has no extractable text layer under any rung of the ladder (pdftotext, pypdf, pdfminer, stream extractor all return 0 chars; the producer is a Print-To-PDF with no /Font or /Image objects) -- it was read by rendering pages to images. The sl_3 side is precisely the A_2 the corpus states it does NOT have: prop:a2-from-three-strands and eightfold-intro make it the chapter's 'central honesty constraint' that their A_2 is the Coxeter A_2 of S_3 on three strands, while the sl_3 = A_2 of flavour SU(3) requires dim V = 3 and the framework supplies dim V = 2. So the corpus has no consumer for an sl_3 web calculus. Scope-(a): this document, as read, supplies nothing usable at the corpus's current blocks; it is not a claim that web/spider methods are excluded.

proposedActions.rationale: The corpus's chain is sl_2/Hecke and explicitly disclaims the sl_3 side; nothing consumes an A_2-web twist formula. The extraction failure is worth recording so a later agent does not re-attempt text extraction on this file.
